purpose: Six-segment 8-second live pipeline bridge acceptance for current subject/wardrobe/location/prop plumbing.
story_text: Amy is medieval barkeep, taking care of a tavern for magical humanoid creatures.
global_rules: Six segments exactly, eight seconds each.
Goblin is already present before its first beat; Elf and Dragon enter later.
Preserve subject identity, canonical appropriate attire, location geometry, and movable-prop identity.
input_subjects: <Subject 1> is Amy, a confident woman referenced in <Picture 1>. <Picture 1> defines Amy's facial identity, facial structure, hair, body proportions, and distinguishing features.

must_happen: Amy wipes a polished table with an ale-scented cloth.
Amy's medieval work clothing is visible.
Goblin may already be present because it has no entry point.
must_not_happen: Elf must not already be present.
Dragon must not already be present.
expected_end_state: Amy remains inside the tavern near the wiped table.
Goblin is the only later-beat Subject eligible to have been present from story start.

must_happen: Goblin is already at the counter with one chipped mug.
Amy refills that mug from the barrel beside the hearth.
must_not_happen: Elf and Dragon must not enter early.
expected_end_state: Goblin remains in the tavern with the same mug.

must_happen: Elf visibly steps into the tavern.
Elf takes a seat at the back table.
Amy serves the elf in a crystal chalice.
must_not_happen: Elf must not have been present from frame zero.
No modern athletic clothing for the elf.
expected_end_state: Elf is seated at the back table with the served chalice.

must_happen: Dragon visibly enters from the doorway.
Dragon moves onto the high bar stool.
Amy serves the dragon a special brew in one crystal cup.
must_not_happen: Dragon must not have been present from story start.
Dragon must not teleport to the stool.
Do not invent clothing when appropriate attire is naturally unclothed.
expected_end_state: Dragon is established at the high bar stool with its drink.

must_happen: Dragon takes a slow sip and exhales contentedly.
Amy wipes the bar with a fresh cloth.
must_not_happen: Drink container must not change identity.
No extra hands or duplicated glasses.
expected_end_state: Dragon remains with the same drink container.

must_happen: Amy steps outside and closes/locks the tavern for the night.
must_not_happen: No reverse-walking patrons caused by continuity drift.
expected_end_state: Amy is outside after closing and locking the tavern.
The tavern is shut for the night.
